model: claude-sonnet-5-5 (claude -p, no tools; first run's agent could not read its file)

quantifiers: a single keyboard (this ... keyboard) -> generic plural 'keyboards'
added: 'at least some of the key features'
other: Original describes one specific product ('optical mechanical'); rewrite generalizes to a class of keyboards and drops 'optical mechanical'
Rewrite adds a claim that these features set the keyboards apart from others
pairs.notes: 'at least some' is a quantifier added in the closing clause.

quantifiers: frequent searches unnecessary -> reducing the need for frequent lookups (all -> reduced)
other: 'rows mapped to a bucket' became 'entries in the same bucket'
Original says frequent searches become unnecessary; rewrite only says need is reduced
pairs.notes: Original is garbled; negation 'does not determine' / 'doesn't predict' judged equivalent.
Essentially faithful. FIBA kept. Synonym-level shifts left out of other except the mild ones noted.

other: 'government business meetings where proposals are debated or initiated for the first time' became 'official parliamentary sessions where new ideas are discussed or first presented'
pairs.notes: The '1.' is list numbering, but listed as a number since it is dropped? Actually '1.' remains in the rewrite, so it is not missing.

other: 'both new perspectives and familiar expectations' became 'new ideas and old habits' (expectations -> habits)

'took time and effort' became 'required patience and work'
'improved communication skills accelerated' became 'it helped us improve communication, speeding things up' (what accelerates is unclear in original)

other: 'reducing fatigue' became 'easing strain during long typing sessions'

più che possibile -> più che at (garbled)
